artifacts.notes: Unchanged full offered OCR: 12680 physical lines. Historical front matter, contents, body, footnotes and terminal matter remain. OCR errors are not corrected; this artifact is a finding and reading witness, not a facsimile or a claim of whole-source collation. Quote only a separately checked locus. The image of the title page says 1869; Internet Archive catalog date 1868 is not controlling. This is the entire offered first volume, not the eight-volume collection. The preface states that the sermons were written and preached between 1825 and 1843; their composition precedes Newman’s reception into the Catholic Church. The editor is not named on the inspected title, so no editor attribution is inferred.
